text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to reduce the length of the existing student pick-up/drop-off zone and amend the existing parking prohibition on the west side of Old Park Road within the "T" of the intersection at Shallmar Boulevard to prohibit stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The proposed changes will enhance traffic flow and provide a greater turning radius for school buses at the intersection of Old Park Road and Shallmar Boulevard.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing fifteen-minute maximum parking limit in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:15 a.m., from 11:15 a.m. to 1:15 p.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Old Park Road, between Ridge Hill Drive and the south end of Elm Ridge Circle, to be in effect between Ridge Hill Drive and a point 75 metres north of Ridge Hill Drive, and between a point 98 metres north of Ridge Hill Drive and the south end of Elm Ridge Circle. 2.
